steps.title: Prepare Antigen Source
steps.instruction: Prepare the antigen source (clarified cellular lysates, purified virions, or recombinant purified protein) for electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Add 1:1 4X Laemmli sample buffer with 10% BME to the antigen source to achieve a final concentration of 2X sample buffer and 5% BME.
Heat the mixture at 100°C for 10 minutes.
Quickspin to collect sample droplets from the top of the snapcap tube.

steps.title: Perform Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the prepared samples on a 2D gel.

substeps.instruction: Load 250 µL of prepared lysate into the large well of a 2D gel.
Load 5 µL of SeeBlue2 ladder (or pre-stained ladder of choice) into the small well.
Perform electrophoresis at 100 V for approximately 1 hour.

steps.title: Transfer and Cut Blot
steps.instruction: Transfer the proteins to a membrane and section the blot into strips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the gel to a membrane using the iBlot system.
Use a ruler and pen to draw a line approximately 0.5 cm from the top edge of the blot.
Using a ruler and razor blade on a pane of glass, cut strips approximately 2 mm in width starting from the far edge of the blot.
Discard the first 5 mm of the far edge.

steps.title: Block and Incubate with Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Block the strips and incubate them with the primary antibody source.

substeps.instruction: Store strips in blocking buffer at 4°C until use.
Allocate the pre-blocked strips to a western incubation dish.
Add 2 µL to 10 µL of sera or blood sample to the well.
Incubate overnight with rocking at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash and Incubate with Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the strips and apply the secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 3X with TBS-T, followed by three 5-minute rinses with TBS-T.
Add 500 µL of 2° antibody to each lane.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark with rocking for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Final Wash and Development
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and develop the strips for scanning.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 3X with TBS-T, followed by three 5-minute rinses with TBS-T.
Remove remaining washing buffer with a pipette.
Add 500 µL developing agent to the blot and incubate in the dark for 30 minutes or until color develops.
Remove strips from the incubation dish and mount on paper to scan.
Store in the dark.
